matReference.name: Music Wire
matReference.note: Highest-quality high-carbon wire. Best fatigue life of the carbon steels; preferred for dynamic / high-cycle service.

matReference.name: Chrome Silicon
matReference.note: Alloy steel for shock, impact and elevated-temperature duty. High allowable stress; common for engine / valve springs.

matReference.name: Stainless 302/304
matReference.note: Austenitic stainless. Good general corrosion resistance; lower allowable stress and modulus than carbon steel.

matReference.name: 17-7 PH Stainless
matReference.note: Precipitation-hardening stainless. Heat-treated after forming for high strength + corrosion + moderate elevated-temperature service.

matReference.name: Oil Tempered
matReference.note: General-purpose pre-tempered carbon steel. Economical for static and moderate-cycle loads; not for high-cycle fatigue or shock.

matReference.name: Hard Drawn
matReference.note: Lowest-cost spring wire. Suited to static / low-cycle, non-critical applications. Avoid fatigue, shock and tight tolerances.

matReference.name: Inconel X-750
matReference.note: Nickel-chromium superalloy for high-temperature and corrosive environments. Expensive; specify only when service conditions require it.

matReference.name: Phosphor Bronze
matReference.note: Copper alloy with good electrical conductivity and corrosion resistance. Low modulus and modest strength; used for contacts / electrical springs.
